practice.name: Michelle Sathekge Occupational Therapy
practice.tagline: EMPOWERING EVERY STEP TOWARDS A MEANINGFUL LIFE
practice.coreMission: To enable people to participate meaningfully in the daily activities, roles and environments that shape their lives through person-centred, evidence-informed occupational therapy.
practice.positioningStatement: Michelle Sathekge Occupational Therapy supports meaningful participation by considering the person, the activity and the environment together. In corporate and industrial contexts, the focus is functional participation and vocational rehabilitation, with recommendations grounded in assessment, consent, professional competence and the actual demands of the role.

locations.name: Midrand Consulting Rooms
locations.address: Woodmead Dr & Dytchley Rd, Barbeque Downs / Plooysville AH, Midrand, 1686

coreValues.description: Treat clients as active participants. Explain assessments and recommendations in accessible language; respect preferences, consent, privacy and individual goals.
Base clinical reasoning on rigorous assessment, current evidence, and professional scope. Document clear rationale and collaborate when needs exceed scope.
Connect intervention to real-world tasks. Consider person, task, and environment together, avoiding defining success merely through impairment metrics.
Communicate transparently, protect confidential data, and collaborate with clients, families, and workplace partners within clear consent boundaries.

clinical.title: Clinical Services
clinical.summary: Evidence-informed assessment and practical rehabilitation empowering individuals to rebuild autonomy, function, and meaningful daily participation.

areas.name: Neuro-Rehabilitation
areas.description: Specialised restorative intervention for neurological conditions to enhance motor control, cognition, and independence in everyday roles.

areas.name: Physical Rehabilitation
areas.description: Comprehensive functional recovery and adaptive retraining for orthopedic injuries, trauma, and post-surgical recovery.

areas.name: Mental Health Rehabilitation
areas.description: Evidence-based occupational therapy supporting emotional regulation, routine structuring, life skills, and social participation. We offer both individual and group therapy sessions.

corporate.title: Vocational & Corporate Rehabilitation
corporate.summary: Assessment-informed support for functional participation, work demands, and structured return-to-work planning.
corporate.scopeNote: Within professional occupational therapy scope; collaborative with occupational health, medical, and safety teams.

services.title: Functional Capacity & Work Role Assessments
services.description: Comprehensive functional evaluations matched directly against the physical, cognitive, and environmental demands of specific job roles.

services.title: Vocational Rehabilitation & Graded Return-to-Work
services.description: Structured, progressive return-to-work planning and rehabilitation coordinated with employees, treating clinicians, and occupational health teams.

services.title: Workstation Ergonomics & Task Adaptation
services.description: Practical adaptation recommendations for physical workstations, tooling, and task sequencing to support safe, sustainable participation.

services.title: Sector-Specific Occupational Support
services.description: Understanding actual job demands across physically demanding sectors including engineering, mining, logistics, manufacturing, and technical trades.

avoid: No claims of employee fitness certification beyond OT scope
No reducing people to injury labels
No claims of existing corporate medical centres (Horizon 2036 vision)
